summary: Fresh test pass: 11 backend tests (5 files) + 8 named browser checks covering all 8 acceptance-matrix criteria for QuantPulse. All passed. One transient backtest-check race (flaky, resolved on rerun). The paper-trading reset check intentionally reset the singleton seeded paper account (equity ~Rs 5,16,599 -> Rs 5,00,000, 54 closed positions -> 0) as that IS the criterion under test; backend paper-trading tests were made tolerant of either state.

checks.criterion: Dashboard shows live market overview and updates without a manual refresh
checks.name: dashboard-live-overview-updates
checks.evidence: Market status bar, NIFTY/BANKNIFTY quote tiles, direction panel all render; quote-ltp-NIFTY text value changed within the 16s poll window with no page reload (screenshots initial/after-wait).

checks.criterion: Direction engine result is explainable and NO TRADE is a valid, reasoned outcome
checks.name: direction-engine-explainable
checks.evidence: direction-value showed SIDEWAYS with direction-score '34/100'; Evaluate now triggered a fresh evaluation (timestamp refreshed); all six factor-row testids (trend/vwap/momentum/breakout/volume/fno) visible on /market-analysis.

checks.criterion: Live Signals page lists seeded signal history with working filters and a full audit detail view
checks.name: live-signals-filters-and-detail
checks.evidence: Stats bar showed Total 54 / Active 10 / Closed 33 / Win rate 36.4%; CALL filter reduced 54->31 rows all CE; NIFTY symbol filter excluded BANKNIFTY rows; detail sheet opened with contract, event log and factor breakdown visible.

checks.criterion: Live Signals page lists seeded signal history with working filters and a full audit detail view
checks.name: test_tscheck_live_signals_audit.py
checks.evidence: GET /signals/analytics -> 200 total_signals=54; GET /signals?option_type=CE/PE and ?symbol=NIFTY all returned only matching rows; GET /signals/{id} contained entry/SL/targets/reasons/strategy_version; GET /notifications?limit=200 -> 100+ rows.

checks.criterion: Option Scanner shows the full CE/PE chain around a dynamic ATM with scores and liquidity rejections
checks.name: option-scanner-chain-and-ranked
checks.evidence: Spot/ATM/max-pain/futures/eligible/rejected metrics and liquidity thresholds rendered; changing expiry and the ATM-range input (10->3) changed the visible chain-row count; ranked view listed ELIGIBLE/rejected verdicts with reasons.

checks.criterion: Market Analysis shows multi-timeframe technicals, F&O structure and the signal explanation
checks.name: market-analysis-timeframe-switch
checks.evidence: Indicators panel, F&O panel and factor list rendered; switching timeframe selector from 5m to 15m changed the rendered chart (byte-diff on chart screenshot) and re-fetched analysis-verdict.

checks.criterion: Backtesting runs as a background job and reports look-ahead-free results with costs separated
checks.name: backtesting-job-lifecycle-and-results
checks.evidence: Submitted NIFTY 5m 2025-06-01..2025-09-01 run; job-status badge showed RUNNING immediately (not a stale prior COMPLETED), progressed to COMPLETED without reload; metrics, equity-curve chart, monthly chart, dataset-split-disclosure, assumptions (slippage/brokerage wording) and trade-log-table all rendered; selecting a previous job row reloaded its metrics. First attempt hit a UI-update timing race (flaky, passed on immediate rerun).

checks.criterion: Backtesting runs as a background job and reports look-ahead-free results with costs separated
checks.name: test_tscheck_backtesting_job.py
checks.evidence: POST /backtest/run -> 200 QUEUED/RUNNING; polled GET /backtest/jobs/{id} to COMPLETED; metrics contained total_trades/gross_pnl/total_costs/net_pnl with net_pnl == gross_pnl - total_costs and gross != net; GET .../trades rows had entry_ts/exit_ts/side/strike/qty/sl/target/pnl/r_multiple/exit_reason/segment; warnings list non-empty.

checks.criterion: Paper trading tracks virtual capital only and never routes a real order
checks.name: paper-trading-reset-and-copy
checks.evidence: Subtitle copy 'No order is ever routed to a real broker or exchange' visible; paper-equity-metric and paper-cash rendered non-zero seeded values pre-reset; Reset virtual account button set equity back to the displayed start-capital figure (Rs 5,00,000).

checks.criterion: Paper trading tracks virtual capital only and never routes a real order
checks.name: test_tscheck_paper_trading_state.py
checks.evidence: GET /paper/account -> 200 start_capital 500000, equity in seeded range (Rs 5,16,599) captured before the browser reset check ran; GET /paper/positions?status=CLOSED returned >=54 rows with entry_price/qty/realized_pnl. Test made tolerant of the post-reset singleton-account state since the paper-trading-reset-and-copy browser check legitimately resets the same account later in the run.

checks.criterion: Settings requires admin auth, validates input, persists changes and mints a new strategy version
checks.name: settings-auth-gate-validation-persistence
checks.evidence: Login form gated before auth; logged in with admin@quantpulse.in/QuantPulse@2026 -> admin-email-badge shown; all 4 tabs clickable; saved min_signal_score change persisted across a full page reload; submitting min_signal_score=150 was rejected (422 captured in console, error copy shown), then value restored.

checks.criterion: Settings requires admin auth, validates input, persists changes and mints a new strategy version
checks.name: test_tscheck_settings_auth_validation.py
checks.evidence: PUT /settings without auth -> 401; POST /auth/login -> 200, GET /auth/me confirmed email; PUT /settings with min_signal_score changed -> 200 with strategy.version bumped and persisted on re-GET; PUT /settings with min_signal_score=150 -> 422.
